observations.behavior: Adds typed option to request parameters for filtering task lists by user-pinned status.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows desktop clients and API consumers to retrieve only pinned tasks without fetching irrelevant items.

observations.behavior: Maps client-side options into URL search params, including pinned, commentedBy, and mentions filters.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects frontend configuration to backend parameter parsing, enabling these filters at ingestion/query time.

observations.behavior: Detects contradictory archived constraints and marks the query as matching no results rather than ignoring them.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves semantic correctness of feed queries when users explicitly exclude both included and excluded archived tasks.

observations.limitations: Only P1 hunks are provided. No implementation or test execution is shown, so actual behavior and compatibility cannot be verified. Tier assignment relies on visible code changes alone.

review.reason: Changes add bounded capability: new filter parameters and a contradiction-handling rule in query planning. This could help PostHog users manage their personal task feeds more precisely; tier 3 requires broader systemic impact not demonstrated here.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant for Desktop and potentially other clients using this API; relevant for reliability by preserving query semantics.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends only on supplied chunk; missing tests and server-side handling prevent full confidence.
